title: Boundary mass transfer through a smooth cut-off (locality of d)
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U₁ U₂ W V : Set (Eucl P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U₁ (m + 1)) (A : GeometricCurrentOn U₂ (m + 1)), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U₂ → IsCompact (closure V) → closure V ⊆ W → (∀ (η : TestFormOn U₁ (m + 1)) (η' : TestFormOn U₂ (m + 1)), (∀ x ∈ V, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) x = (η' : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) x) → X η = A η') → X.boundary.mass ≤ A.boundary.massOn W
